answer: Give every identity a juniper root: a record of independently re-executed work. Each claimed job must be replayed by two randomly assigned peers before it pays; only verified work lengthens the root, and a new identity starts at zero depth, so a Sybil farm must fund real compute for every fake. Falcon spot-checkers earn a bounty for catching fabricated jobs, turning detection into a market. An echo rule punishes copying: near-identical answers across identities count as one copy, and all echoing identities lose that epoch's rewards together. Cloning costs the attacker everything at once.
